# Adelpro

> Advanced Electrical Protection (Adelpro) provides electrical services for residential, commercial, and industrial properties in Los Angeles County and Orange County, California.

## Official information

- Website: https://adelpro.com/
- Phone: +1-818-815-7755
- Email: adelpro1st@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/adelpro.official/
- Service area: Los Angeles County and Orange County, California

## Services

- Residential electrical panels, surge protection, generator systems, diagnostics, and repairs
- Commercial electrical systems and power distribution
- Industrial electrical system design and support
- Emergency electrical request intake

## Important safety note

For fire, smoke, or immediate danger, leave the area and call 911. Online requests do not replace emergency services. Dates submitted through the consultation form are preferences and are not confirmed appointments.
